records.verificationNote: Searched Wegovy, Zepbound, Saxenda, semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, obesity and weight terms: no match. The document does not say weight-loss drugs are excluded, and says the list is not full, so absence is not treated as confirmed exclusion. Closed-formulary language ("if a drug is not listed, a formulary exception may be asked for") is noted, not used to conclude exclusion. [Sonnet check 2026-10-21: PDL wording read as one consistent whole: it is a preferred-drug list, not a full list (p.1: "All Georgia Medicaid drugs are covered by CareSource. This is just a list of preferred drugs." and "It is also not meant to be a full list."); the "closed formulary" sentence (p.3: "If a drug is not listed, a formulary exception may be asked for coverage") is boilerplate and is not used to infer exclusions. A drug absent from the list is therefore unconfirmed, not excluded: it is covered if Georgia Medicaid covers it, likely through PA or exception review. Context only, not cited as a source: the Georgia Medicaid FFS PDL eff. 10/1/2026 lists Saxenda as non-preferred, PA (ages 12-17); Wegovy and Zepbound are not on it. Ozempic and Rybelsus on this PDL are diabetes products and are not weight-loss coverage.]
